domain: Public Health and Safety Inspection Management
scenario:
A regional public health department is implementing an enterprise-level Inspection Management System to oversee the health and safety compliance of food service facilities. The system will manage inspections, track facility compliance, and maintain comprehensive records of inspection activities and outcomes. The platform aims to enhance transparency and efficiency in monitoring public health standards across various facilities such as retail markets and restaurants.

The system will record detailed information about each facility, including ownership, location, and risk level. Inspections will be conducted regularly, and inspectors will document their findings, including scores, grades, and any violations. The system will also track the status of compliance programs at each facility and provide analytics to assess trends in compliance and non-compliance.

The public health department requires the system to support a wide range of users, including inspectors, facility owners, and administrators. The platform should offer role-based access to ensure that sensitive information is protected while allowing facility owners to view their inspection results and compliance status. Additionally, the system should facilitate communication between inspectors and facility owners to resolve any issues identified during inspections.
